text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — spike in 5xxs on /v1/generate (hosted). Alerting eng-oncall. link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/2034567890 :rotating_light:
Alex R: on it. grabbing logs and current on-call table. who’s primary right now?
Maria L: I’m primary until 2034567910 (UTC). just got the page, will triage.
Jon P: infra here — I can take secondary. first check: GPU queue length and node OOMs.
Tara K: runtime — could be KV cache mismatch after the last rollout. check redis cache hits + kv-cache-errors. also check model variant fallback logs.
Maria L: seeing a sharp bump in 500s from instances in us-west-2. latency also up ~200ms p50 -> p90. adding runbook pointer: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/generic-5xx-handling
SupportBot: Customer impact: multiple Prod customers reporting degraded responses (CS tickets: #4521, #4523). Estimated affected sessions: ~180 active requests/minute.
Alex R: Maria — if your shift ends at 2034567910 and this persists past that, we need to hand off. Jon, can you be primary after 2034567910?
Jon P: yes I’ll rotate primary at 2034567910. I’ll also coordinate with infra-sre to check autoscaler behavior.
Tara K: quick mitigation checklist I’m running: 1) roll back last runtime config diff 2) clear KV cache on a subset 3) force routing to older model variant (model:v1.3-safe)
Maria L: rollback of last config gave temporary relief on two nodes. but new nodes still unhealthy. shared logs: ```
ERR: kv-cache-reconcile failed: key mismatch
WARN: fallback to model:v1.3-safe
```
Kevin S: security triage — no unusual auth failures or surge from single IP range. not seeing signs of malicious traffic.
Alex R: action items: Maria keep triage until 2034567910, Jon take over after that. Tara continue runtime checks and prepare a canary rollback. Kevin monitor for any auth anomalies. Support: update impacted customers with ETA 30m.
Maria L: adding note: coverage gap from 2034568000-2034568600 — I have a PTO start at 2034568000 (short notice). Jon, any chance you can cover extended window if issue persists?
Jon P: I can extend but pinging infra-sre for backup. tagging @infra-oncall (FYI).
Tara K: if rollback to model:v1.3-safe removes errors, we should keep it for at least 1 hour and run regression eval. I’ll prepare a quick prompt eval set.
SupportBot: Posted update to affected customers and created follow-up ticket for postmortem.
Alex R: good. logging this thread to incident doc and will run blameless postmortem once stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria L: handing off now — passing primary to Jon at 2034567910. leaving pointers in pager duty note.
Jon P: I’m primary now. starting deeper infra checks (autoscaler, node pools, kube events). notifying eng-sre channel.
Tara K: runtime note saved in runbook under "model fallback". linking quick fix snippet: ``kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/runtime-deploy --to-revision=12``
Kevin S: monitoring continues. no changes in threat indicators.
Alex R: keep updates brief in this thread. if you escalate to executive pager, ping me directly.
Jon P: update 2034567925 — found a misconfigured autoscaler policy that prevented scale-up during burst. applying fix now, we should see node provisioning in ~90s.
Maria L: thanks, gl.
Tara K: standing by to trigger canary rollback if error rate doesn't drop in 2 mins.
incident-bot: INCIDENT status changed to "mitigating" (assigned: Jon P, Tara K).
Jon P: error rate dropping, p90 latency trending down. will monitor for 15m and then declare stable.
Alex R: great work team. capture remediation steps and coverage notes in the postmortem doc.
